description: Search the web and read pages through providers you switch on and configure: Tavily, Brave Search, Wikipedia and DuckDuckGo.

settings.label: Tavily
settings.hint: AI-agent search with page reading. Free plan: 1,000 credits a month. Needs the tavily_api_key credential.

settings.label: Brave Search
settings.hint: Independent web index. About $5 of free credit a month (roughly 1,000 searches) and Brave attribution on your site. Needs the brave_search_api_key credential.

settings.label: Wikipedia
settings.hint: Free encyclopedic results from English Wikipedia; no key.

settings.label: DuckDuckGo
settings.hint: Free, no key, but often blocks automated searches. Best kept as a last-resort fallback.

settings.label: Provider order
settings.hint: Comma-separated order to try enabled providers in. Unknown names are ignored.

settings.label: Fall back to the next provider
settings.hint: ON tries the next enabled provider when one fails, has no key or is over its cap. OFF stops at the first failure.

settings.label: Results per search
settings.hint: Default number of results when the agent doesn't ask for a specific count.

settings.label: Tavily monthly cap
settings.hint: Requests per calendar month (UTC) for each user before Tavily is skipped. 0 means no cap.

settings.label: Brave monthly cap
settings.hint: Requests per calendar month (UTC) for each user before Brave is skipped. 0 means no cap.

migration_note: Executable plugin (requests_v1). Providers are declared in plugin.json; the host makes each provider call, adds the caller's vault key and counts monthly use, so the sandboxed plugin never sees keys or the network.
skill_summary: Web search across switchable providers, and reading one page as text, with explicit error codes and recovery hints.
